headline.zh: 协调农场现场团队运营

scenario.zh: 管理500人采收团队,需追踪每日产量、质检照片和设备报修,减少主管人工汇总时间
scenario.en: Manage 500-person harvest crew tracking daily yields, quality photos and equipment repairs to reduce manual supervisor consolidation

instruction.zh: 选择现场团队主要使用的沟通方式
instruction.en: Choose the primary communication method for field teams

output.zh: 面板显示23条消息和4通电话待处理,包含产量数字、照片和语音
output.en: Board shows 23 messages and 4 calls pending, containing yield numbers, photos and voice notes

output.zh: 面板显示7通电话待处理,全部为语音描述,缺少可视化质检信息
output.en: Board shows 7 calls pending, all voice descriptions, missing visual quality inspection data

instruction.zh: 决定AI代理如何转化非结构化现场反馈
instruction.en: Decide how the AI agent transforms unstructured field feedback

output.zh: 面板将消息归入产量报告、质检照片、设备报修三个栏目,数字和图片已关联
output.en: Board organizes messages into yield reports, quality photos, equipment repairs with linked numbers and images

output.zh: 面板按时间顺序显示所有消息,主管需手动查找关键信息并归类
output.en: Board shows all messages chronologically, supervisor must manually find and categorize key information

instruction.zh: 查看两种方式下主管的跟进任务差异
instruction.en: Review differences in supervisor follow-up tasks between two approaches

output.zh: 面板显示3条待办:东区进度慢需调人,2号质检照片模糊需重拍,拖拉机维修已派单
output.en: Board shows 3 tasks: East area needs more workers, photo #2 blurry needs retake, tractor repair dispatched

output.zh: 主管需阅读全部原始消息,自行判断哪些需跟进并逐条创建任务卡片
output.en: Supervisor must read all raw messages, judge which need follow-up and manually create task cards

instruction.zh: 检查AI代理整理的当日运营摘要
instruction.en: Check the daily operations summary organized by the AI agent

output.zh: 简报包含各区产量对比、质检合格率趋势、设备故障类型统计,可直接报告管理层
output.en: Brief includes yield comparison by area, quality pass rate trends, equipment failure statistics for management reporting

output.zh: 获得按时间排列的消息和通话记录文本文件,仍需人工分析提炼
output.en: Receive text file of messages and call logs in chronological order, still requires manual analysis

takeaway.zh: AI代理将现场碎片化沟通转为可执行任务和决策数据,减少主管整理时间
takeaway.en: AI agent converts fragmented field communication into actionable tasks and decision data, reducing supervisor consolidation time

initial.zh: 今日采收目标:东区芒果园12吨,质检每两小时拍照上传,设备故障立即上报
initial.en: Today's harvest target: East mango orchard 12 tons, quality photos every 2 hours, report equipment issues immediately
